Package com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka

Class ConfigDiff

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka.ConfigDiff
public final class ConfigDiff extends Object
Compares a desired config against the current config for a Kafka topic or broker and reports the per-key differences. Both sides are plain Map<String,String> so this stays Kafka-type-free and fully pure/offline- testable: callers read the live config into a map, build the map they want, and hand both here. Each key is classified ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / UNCHANGED. Keys can be marked read-only (non-updatable, such as broker static configs); a change on such a key is still reported but flagged so a UI can warn instead of attempting to apply it. Entries are sorted by key for stable, testable output, and all results are immutable defensive copies.

    • compare

      public static ConfigDiff compare(Map<String,String> desired, Map<String,String> current, Set<String> readOnlyKeys)
      Compares desired against current, flagging any key in readOnlyKeys as non-updatable. Null maps are treated as empty; a null read-only set is treated as none. The inputs are defensively copied and never retained.
